name: seo-ai-readiness-audit
title: SEO & AI-Readiness Site Audit (0-100 score, EN/JA report)
description: Crawls a website, audits every page for SEO issues (title, meta description, H1, canonical, noindex, alt text, structured data, broken links) and AI-search readiness (llms.txt, AI crawler blocks). Outputs a 0-100 score and an HTML report in English or Japanese.
